Guide design reference

The agreed starting template for guides and general game information. These are component examples, not game rules.

Text and spacing

Use a clear opening sentence, bold for important phrases, italic for emphasis, and underline sparingly. Keep paragraphs short enough to scan.

  1. Lead with the practical information.
  2. Explain the relevant details.
  3. State specific uncertainty without adding unrelated warnings.

Info and disclaimer boxes

Info box. Use this yellow box for useful explanations, tips and examples.
Disclaimer box. Use the same box with a warning icon for a specific limitation or unverified mechanic.
